subject.title: Feature: Agent 动态切换命令（不重启 Gateway）

question: Should OpenClaw support channel/session-scoped `/agent <name>` switching for configured agents, and which authorization policy controls what each channel sender can list or select?
rationale: The request crosses product UX, channel routing, session persistence, and security boundaries; automation should not choose whether configured agents become channel-selectable or how cross-agent access is authorized.

options.title: Guarded session switch
options.body: Add a session-scoped switch that lists and selects only explicitly authorized configured agents, with clear storage and cleanup semantics.

options.title: Keep static routing plus focus
options.body: Decline configured-agent switching and keep channel routing limited to bindings/defaults plus existing `/focus` session-target controls.

options.title: Add a plugin/API seam first
options.body: Expose the missing generic routing hook so a channel or plugin can implement this policy without adding one-off core behavior.

recommendation.title: Guarded session switch
recommendation.body: Add a session-scoped switch that lists and selects only explicitly authorized configured agents, with clear storage and cleanup semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision combines routing policy and security posture, and steipete has the strongest adjacent history on central route resolution.
